verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents its registered-agent renewal terms: $249/year that auto-renews at the purchase rate until cancelled, with the renewal rate subject to change and the purchase price limited to first-time customers. It also states "Cancel anytime." The transfer paperwork it describes runs only inward (switching to LegalZoom as agent), so nothing shows how a departing customer's entity is protected when leaving. Missing for 10: documented cancellation procedure and effective-date/refund terms, transfer-out or RA-resignation handling with the Secretary of State, notice of renewal-rate changes, and independent corroboration of renewal/cancellation behavior.
